label: single-venue (Nasdaq) execution benchmark v2 on a 20-name universe, three in-sample days, per liquidity bucket; SECONDARY, no promotion, no edge claim
primary_metric: cost_per_filled_share_bps (REL-03 benchmark v2, pooled ratio, CR1 by session)

parameters.mde_report: print mde and mde_t (80 % power, two-sided 5 %) for every bucket x cell; a cell whose MDE exceeds its point estimate is labelled 'not informative'

fixed.clusters: session (G = 3): the interval is wide by design and the small-G limitation is printed with every number

open_parameter_notes.sizes_pct_venue_adv: the benchmark sizes parents on Nasdaq (venue) ADV; suggested 0.1,0.5,1,2
open_parameter_notes.sizes_target_pct_consolidated_adv: OPEN until volume_check.json exists (owner freezes then): venue % x median Nasdaq/consolidated ratio over the 14 validated names (the 6 unavailable names are excluded); record it before the benchmark runs
open_parameter_notes.mde_report: suggested: print mde and mde_t (80 % power, two-sided 5 %) for every bucket x cell; a cell whose MDE exceeds its point estimate is labelled 'not informative'

volume_validation.option: 1 (owner, 2026-10-20): keep all 20 names; validate on the 14 with Yahoo data; flag 6 as unavailable
volume_validation.reason: Yahoo has no data for these six (delisted / acquired)
volume_validation.handling: no ratio and no consolidated ADV; sized on Nasdaq venue ADV only; the benchmark output states they have no consolidated-volume validation; the median Nasdaq/consolidated ratio (sizes_target_pct_consolidated_adv) is computed on the 14 validated names only
